record.one_liner: Ramp: spend management, corporate cards, bill pay and expense reporting for businesses, with a Developer API for Transactions, Reimbursements, Cards and other business data.
record.auth_notes: Client Credentials: client_id:client_secret sent as Basic auth to /developer/v1/token for a bearer token (server-to-server). Authorization Code (with optional Refresh Token) for third-party apps with user consent. Basic-auth client secret treated as api_key per rubric; token exchange is OAuth 2.0 so oauth2 also listed.
record.access_notes: Any Ramp customer admin creates a developer app under Company > Developer; Ramp Free plan is $0/mo/user so no paid tier is needed to get credentials. Sandbox via a sandbox access request. critic: access re-derived, self_serve_free confirmed; pricing page does not list API as a paid add-on.
record.api_notes: REST endpoints on api.ramp.com (sandbox demo-api.ramp.com); OpenAPI spec at /openapi/developer-api.json. Product areas: Banking, Bill Pay, Cards, Procurement, Reimbursements, Spend Controls, Users.
record.blocker_notes: No blocker found. critic: mcp confirmed official; mcp_url changed from the GitHub repo to the vendor-hosted remote server (ramp-public/ramp_mcp also exists).

evidence.quote: Send `client_id:client_secret`, base64-encoded, in an `Authorization: Basic ...` header.
Best for smaller teams who want to simplify finances.
Any tool that supports remote MCP servers with OAuth can connect to https://mcp.ramp.com/mcp.
